tags.name: REST APIs
tags.description: These APIs are used to manage and synchronize entities in Reva using the REST protocol. Any invalid records that result in errors should be retried by the caller.

put.description: Performs a bulk replacement of existing entities in Reva using the provided data. This operation completely overwrites existing records.

parameters.name: entityTypeId
parameters.description:
Unique identifier for the entity type.

To find the `entityTypeId`, follow these steps:

- Go to **Manage Policies** and select the target policy store.
- Open the **Data** tab and click the **Configure** spanner icon.
- Copy the **Entity Type ID** for the entity type you want to use.

example.message: Entity ID must not be blank
Invalid Entity type ID
Some error has occured, Please contact administrator

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description: Name of the SCIM resource type

RevaAttribute.description: Attribute of a Reva entity, represented as a name-value pair.

entityId.description: Unique identifier of the child entity.

RevaChild.description: Child entity related to a Reva entity.

attributes.description: Set of attributes associated with the entity.

parents.description: Set of parent entities related to this entity.

children.description: Set of child entities related to this entity.

RevaEntity.description: DTO representing a Reva entity with attributes, parents, and children.

entityId.description: Unique identifier of the parent entity.

RevaParent.description: Parent entity related to a Reva entity.

entityTypeId.description: Unique type identifier of the entity
